Ann Adventure]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 54 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |location={{rt|9|Kanto}} }} '''Pidgeotto Pick-Me-Up''' (Japanese: '''VS ピジョン ''' ''VS {{tt|Pigeon|Pidgeotto}}'') is the 54th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} tells [[Pika]] to look after [[Kitty]] while she runs a quick errand. After Yellow races off, Kitty spots a [[Pokémon food|leaf]] floating past it, and chases after it. The leaf floats over to the edge of the cliff, so Pika chases after Kitty to stop it from falling off the edge. Kitty then chases the leaf and almost runs into a cactus, but Pika runs in front of Kitty, then blows the leaf away. The leaf then flies off in a gust of wind. With Kitty starting to get hungry, Pika decides to feed it a different leaf, causing it to get sick. Suddenly a herd of {{p|Pidgeotto}} fly past and pick Kitty up in the process. Pika climbs the cliff, and then jumps off and {{m|Thunder Shock|shocks}} the Pidgeotto. The Pidgeotto drops Kitty, and Pika catches it. They land on the cliff, next to a tree with rosebud flowers. Kitty eats them, recovering from its sickness. Later, Yellow comes back with her arms full of rosebuds. She smiles as she notices Kitty sleeping next to Pika, with a rosebud adorning the former's head. ==Major events== * {{adv|Yellow}} names her [[Kitty|Caterpie]] Kitty. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Pidgeotto}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pidgey}} (×2) * {{p|Pidgeotto}} ==Trivia== * This chapter is included in [[The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow]]. * This chapter bears a strong resemblance to a mission from [[Hey You, Pikachu!]] called [[Hey You, Pikachu!#Mission Types|Caring For Caterpie]], in which {{p|Pikachu}} and the {{player}} must supervise several baby {{p|Caterpie}} and feed them rosebuds. ** The '''rosebuds''' (Japanese: '''べにつぼみ''') appear as actual items in the game. ===Errors=== * In the [[VIZ Media]] and [[Chuang Yi]] releases, the rosebuds are referred to as "vermilion flowers". ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 比比鳥|VS Pidgeotto}} (Taiwan)
